content: Who is Sonar? Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position description As Director of GTM Productivity & Revenue Enablement, you will focus on improving the effectiveness of our go-to-market teams by building the skills, processes, and tools that help teams execute and serve customers better. This leader will own GTM enablement and productivity, including identifying and scaling AI use cases that increase capacity, improve execution, and accelerate impact. This includes leading (but not limited to) the global enablement function across Sonar's go-to-market organisation, spanning Sales, Customer Success, and Partner teams. Reporting to the CVP of Revenue Operations, you will own the strategy, programmes, and systems that shorten ramp time, lift quota attainment, and equip our GTM teams to sell a technical product into developer, platform, and security buyers. This is equal parts leadership role and builder role. Sonar is a fast-growing company in a fast-changing market, and our enablement function is a work in progress. You will inherit a small team and the foundations of a programme: some of it is working well, some of it needs to be rebuilt, and some of it does not yet exist. Position description As a member of one of our engineering teams, you'll be a key player in making SonarQube Cloud and SonarQube Server the best tools for Code Quality and Security, providing new features to deliver high-quality and powerful products and services that help our users write better software. While keeping our roadmap and business priorities in mind, you will be able to have a high impact on the software that we own and develop. By joining us you will bring your experience and expertise to help push our product to its next stage of evolution and fulfill the needs of our large user and customer base.
